test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**richness**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a noun that fits the context of "highlight cultural (4)___________".
 
• The word "richness" is a noun that appropriately describes the quality of being rich or abundant, particularly in culture.
 
• "Richest" and "richer" are comparative and superlative adjectives, which do not fit grammatically here.
 
• "Richly" is an adverb and does not suit the noun requirement in the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Newspapers are like mirrors **reflecting __(1) **the diverse facets of society, capturing the voices, stories, and events that define our shared human experience. They serve as a forum **__for __(2) **dialogue, debate, and discussion, amplifying voices from all walks of life and fostering __**a (3)**__sense of community. Beyond reporting news, newspapers also celebrate achievements, highlight cultural __**richness**__, **(4) **and showcase human resilience in the face of adversity. They are archives of history, chronicling the triumphs and trials of generations, and serving as a reminder of how far we have come and how much further we can go. In an age of digital transformation, newspapers continue to ______(5), adapting to new mediums while upholding the core values of journalism: accuracy, integrity, and accountability.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Richest: This comparative form does not fit grammatically.
 
• Richer: This comparative form does not fit grammatically.
 
• Richly: This adverb form does not suit the noun requirement in the context.
